source: For example, a matrix kernel may know exactly whichZXMATH0000XZ andZXMATH0001XZ tiles will be used by a thread block. Staging those tiles in shared memory creates deterministic reuse. A general hardware cache does not receive that high-level intent. It sees a stream of memory requests and applies its own policies.
zh: 例如，矩阵内核可以确切地知道线程块将使用哪个ZXMATH0000XZ和ZXMATH0001XZ图块。将这些图块暂存在共享内存中可实现确定性重用。通用硬件缓存不接收该高级意图。它看到内存请求流并应用自己的策略。
